facts.fact: The Appropriation (2026) Act, 2025 (Act No. 6 of 2025) appropriates ZiG258,292,000 from the Consolidated Revenue Fund to Programme I, Policy and Administration, of Vote 23, the Ministry of Information Communication Technology, Postal and Courier Services, for 2026; the line also covers the ministry's postal and courier administration.
